topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't help but let the words hang in the air a moment longer than they should. "Across the country?" I finally manage, my voice hovering just above a whisper. It's such a vast distance, one that feels impossibly wide, especially when it's about to stretch between the closest of friends. We've been through so much together, and now... this? I feel the corners of my mouth try to turn up in some sort of automatic, almost apologetic smile, but it's a struggle. "When did you find out?" I ask, hoping the pause before doesn't give away more than I intend. It's a lot to process, and I wonder how our plans, our future, will now have to morph into something entirely different.
